subject: Urgent: Opal Ledger checkout errors / urgent exec bridge
messages:
From: Sarah Mendoza <sarah.mendoza@opal-ledger.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: ops@opal-ledger.com, kevin.liu@opal-ledger.com
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: [URGENT] Checkout failures + latency blast — production impact

Aditya —

We started seeing severe latency spikes and 5xx error rates across checkout endpoints at ~08:50 PT. Error rate jumped to ~12% and p50 latency moved from 120ms to 2.3s; p99 is above 6s for many requests. This is hitting customers and our merchant transactions are timing out.

We’ve already throttled some non-essential traffic but business impact is material (we've had two payment providers report dropped requests). We need an executive-level bridge and a clear mitigation plan. Our SREs (cc Kevin) have captured logs and a brief postmortem snippet — attaching a tail of the error stream.

Questions:
- Can Redwood open an exec bridge now?
- Can you confirm whether any routing or capacity changes were pushed in the last 30m?
- What quick mitigations can you apply (routing rollback, temporary capacity burst, fallback to model variant)?

This is P0 for us. If we don’t see a plan in the next 30 minutes we will consider pausing production flows.

—Sarah
Sarah Mendoza
CTO, Opal Ledger

Attachments: opal-debug-log-0529.txt (text)
From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: sarah.mendoza@opal-ledger.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Checkout failures + latency blast — production impact

Sarah —

Thanks for the heads-up and the logs. I’m escalating immediately and we’ll stand up an exec bridge.

Planned immediate actions (first 30m):
- Executive bridge at 09:30 PT (join link being created) — I’ll host and loop in our CRO/CTO if needed.
- Jonas (infra) to validate whether a routing or autoscaler change was deployed in the last hour.
- Marcus (platform) to initiate capacity burst and short-term isolation of Opal traffic to avoid noisy neighbors.
- Marissa (CS) to prepare a candid customer status note for Opal leadership.

Sarah, I’ll post the bridge link in 5 mins. Please add any telemetry or APM traces you want us to prioritize ahead of the call.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, sarah.mendoza@opal-ledger.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Checkout failures + latency blast — production impact

Aditya / Sarah —

Quick diagnostic so we have a shared starting point:
- No scheduled control-plane change in the last 2 hours (verified).
- I can see a sudden queue growth on the rotor serving Opal’s model variant starting at 08:47 PT. Concurrent requests spike -> batching grows -> KV cache thrash on one pool. That manifests as p99 latency jumping and 5xxs when queue timeouts occur.
- Initial suspicion: a recent routing tweak (canary to route more requests to the cheap-quantized variant) increased tail load on a constrained pool.

Immediate mitigations I’d recommend now:
1) Roll back the canary routing change (5–10m).
2) Hot-add capacity to the Dedicated pool for Opal (+2 nodes) — Marcus can do this.
3) Temporarily limit max-batch-size to reduce queueing for short RPCs.

I’ve attached a clipped debug log from 08:45–09:10 (opal-debug-log-0529.txt). I’ll join the bridge in 2 mins.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: sarah.mendoza@opal-ledger.com, aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com
Cc: marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft status update for Opal execs — please review

Hi all —

Following the bridge, here’s a short, customer-facing status update for Sarah and Opal execs. Please review and approve or edit inline. I’m proposing we send this to Opal’s exec distribution at 10:15 PT.

--- DRAFT ---
Subject: Opal Ledger — Incident update (May 29)
Body:
Team —
We are actively investigating increased latency and intermittent 5xx errors impacting checkout flows. Our engineering team has identified an induced queueing issue related to a recent routing adjustment and is rolling back that change now. We have also increased capacity for your dedicated pool and applied a temporary batch-size cap to reduce tail latency.
Impact: elevated p50/p95/p99 latency and ~10–13% 5xx rate between 08:47–09:30 PT affecting a subset of merchant transactions.
Next updates: we will follow up within 60 minutes with a summary of fixes and any compensatory actions (including proposed SLA credits).
Contact: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com for exec liaison; marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com for CS
--- end draft ---

I’ve attached a short SLA credits proposal for approval (sla-credits-draft-20260530.pdf). Marcus — once you confirm the rollback and capacity changes I’ll finalize the note and send.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com, jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sarah.mendoza@opal-ledger.com
Date: Fri, 29 May 2026 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft status update for Opal execs — please review

All —

Rollback complete at 10:12 PT; verified immediate reduction in queue depth and drop in 5xx rate. We added +2 nodes to the dedicated pool (temporary burst) and set max-batch-size override to 8 for Opal. Initial telemetry shows p50 down from 2.3s to 180ms over 15 minutes; p99 trending down but still elevated (~1.2s).

I’ll keep monitoring and will post a 60-minute summary. Marissa — you can send the customer note now.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Platform Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah Mendoza <sarah.mendoza@opal-ledger.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kevin.liu@opal-ledger.com, ops@opal-ledger.com
Date: Sat, 30 May 2026 18:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Opal Ledger — Incident update (May 29)

Aditya / Marissa / Marcus —

Thank you for the swift response and the clear comms. We appreciate the rollback and the capacity increase — the traffic has stabilized and our payments team reports normalizing throughput.

We’d like this incident recorded in the joint post-incident review and to receive the SLA credit proposal formally. I’ve scheduled a short follow-up meeting Monday morning to review the root cause and durable mitigations; I’ll invite our head of payments and Kevin (SRE).

Please include your execs if you plan to discuss contractual or credit decisions.

—Sarah
